purpose: Record the bounded Evidence Trust Plane, Documentation Truth, repository-provider security-preservation, explicit bypass-intent semantics, Cloudflare remote-read MCP operator invariants, and pre-deploy provider-native rollback receipt invariant for this candidate without claiming durable receipt persistence, live provider mutation, merge authority, deployment authority, rollback execution, secret installation, or live production truth.

claims: src/evidence/evidenceLifecycle.ts: evidence authority must fail closed at use time when a receipt is expired, stale, superseded, unledgered, rejected, or not bound through GitHub API readback to an exact repository, full SHA, workflow, and run identity; a receipt may prepare review but can never authorize merge, deploy, production promotion, secret changes, policy changes, or deletion by itself.

public/control-room/evidence-trust.html: the founder-facing Evidence Trust Plane must describe durable receipt storage as not wired by this slice, preserve observation versus verification versus authority boundaries, and keep evidence-state, may-unlock, and still-blocked labels available on mobile instead of presenting contract-only capability as implemented persistence.

.github/workflows/playwright.yml: the exact-head Playwright lane must execute the Evidence Trust Plane desktop and mobile proof when this authority surface changes; browser rendering proof remains non-authorizing and cannot prove provider mutation, durable persistence, merge authority, deployment authority, or production truth.

scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs: Documentation Truth must classify the Evidence Trust Plane source, founder-facing page, and Playwright authority workflow as evidence-authority truth-sensitive paths so architecture changes cannot false-green with zero truth-sensitive files; changing this verifier remains truth-governance and requires the corresponding current documentation refresh.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: existing non-FCR ruleset reconciliation MUST preserve the stronger current enforcement level and MUST NOT demote an active or evaluate ruleset when a narrower caller requests weaker enforcement.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: existing non-FCR ruleset reconciliation MUST union existing included branch refs with requested refs and MUST preserve existing excluded refs so a caller cannot silently narrow the provider-owned protected scope.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: omitted bypassActors MUST preserve the current provider bypass posture, an explicit empty bypassActors list MUST clear all provider bypass actors, and a non-empty replacement MUST fail closed until a separately authorized provider-aware contract can represent bypass mode and prove the replacement is non-widening; this source contract does not itself prove live provider state.

src/http/routes/projects.ts: the founder ruleset route MUST preserve the semantic difference between an omitted bypassActors field and an explicit empty array so non-FCR provider reconciliation can distinguish preserve-current from clear-all intent; the route remains founder-authenticated and reservation/idempotency guarded before provider mutation.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts: GitHub repository-provider construction must route through SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider while preserving the existing LazyRepositoryProvider boundary, GitHub App credential preference, FCR constitutional governance checks, exact reviewed base/head freshness membrane, and unchanged GitLab provider behavior.

src/providers/rulesetSecurityMerge.ts: narrowing requested required-status contexts may remove unrequested check contexts but must not silently weaken stronger existing pull-request protections, deletion/non-fast-forward rules, unmanaged provider security rules, or retained status-check provider metadata for contexts that remain requested.

wrangler.worker.toml: the canonical Worker must bind FCR_REMOTE_MCP_READ_PROJECTS only to chief-ai-machine,founder-control-room and must require FCR_REMOTE_MCP_READ_TOKEN as a secret name without committing a secret value; this source wiring cannot prove the secret is installed or that the live /mcp/read endpoint is reachable.

.github/workflows/deploy.yml: after exact-head production authority succeeds and before Supabase, Worker, or Pages mutation begins, the canonical Deploy workflow must require a read-only rollback-snapshot job that captures and retains provider-native Worker deployment/version coordinates plus the current successful Pages production deployment ID; failure to capture the exact rollback targets must block release rather than deploying without rollback preparation.

scripts/capture-production-rollback-receipt.mjs: the pre-deploy receipt must remain credential-free and mutation-free, bind the intended exact release SHA to the live Worker SHA, active Worker deployment/version traffic distribution, and eligible Pages production deployment, and fail closed when those rollback coordinates are absent or malformed; receipt creation is rollback preparation evidence, not rollback execution or rollback-success proof.
